title: Executable RuntimeBinding owner and paper worker heartbeat owner for dev paper baseline

root_cause_analysis.prior_task_diagnosis: LOOP-L08-PERSONA-PROVISIONING-RECONCILE-001 recorded that dev hosted redeploy failed because RuntimeManagerClient.list_by_plan(plan_id) returned 0 active bindings and list_authoritative_paper_runtime_monitoring_sessions() returned 0 sessions, and it explicitly punted the two 'missing owners' (RuntimeBinding creation, paper worker heartbeat publication) to this task.
root_cause_analysis.finding_1_runtime_binding_owner_already_: services/deployment/outbox_consumer_worker.py (event_type == 'runtime.binding.requested' branch, ~lines 2160-2308) is already the single, fully-wired integration point that the deployment saga uses to promote an approved DeploymentPlan into an active RuntimeBinding. It: (a) preflights via RuntimeManagerClient.list_by_plan(plan_id) to recover any binding the saga may have lost track of (fail-closed on ambiguous/unreadable state, line ~2172-2184), (b) calls services/deployment/runtime_manager_dispatch_adapter.py::dispatch_to_runtime_manager which is the sole binding-creation/verification path (deploy() or promote(), never a parallel path), (c) requires an authoritative GET readback (not just the POST receipt) before reporting success (dispatch_adapter.py lines 566-615), and (d) records binding_created/runtime_active saga transitions only after that authoritative readback. services/runtime-manager/runtime_manager_client.py::list_by_plan (lines 154-159) and ::deploy/get/promote are the sole HTTP/local dispatch surface; RuntimeBindingStore is never touched directly by control-plane code. No functional gap, TODO, stub, or wrong condition was found in this path. The recorded zero-binding observation on the dev host reflects that no admitted DeploymentPlan had yet been dispatched through this path on that host (an upstream trigger/deploy-authority concern outside this artifact set), not a defect inside the declared owner code.
root_cause_analysis.finding_2_paper_worker_heartbeat_owner_a: services/execution/lean_runtime/paper_runtime.py::PaperRuntimeService.start() (line 2565) unconditionally emits a startup heartbeat (_maybe_emit_heartbeat, line 3196) and then starts a dedicated heartbeat thread (_heartbeat_loop, line 2742) that emits on a fixed cadence independent of signal-drain backlog. RuntimeTelemetryEmitter.emit_heartbeat (line 2011) -> RuntimeBindingResolver.resolve() (line 1620) fails closed (returns None, records a real last_error, never fabricates a binding_id or a default identifier) when no active RuntimeBinding exists for the worker's runtime_id, and RuntimeTelemetryEmitter.build_event refuses to build a payload without every required identity field (binding_id, runtime_id, capital_pool_id, artifact_id, artifact_version, plan_id, persona_capital_binding_id all required, line 1759-1770). services/paper_fleet_reconciler/paper_fleet_reconciler.py (out of scope, read for context only) spawns exactly one paper_runtime.py subprocess per active RuntimeBinding returned by the runtime-manager's fleet desired-state endpoint, and separately polls telemetry's /api/telemetry/runtime-summaries to populate monitoring_sessions with last_heartbeat_at, which services/control-plane/bff/ports/read_surface_ports.py::list_authoritative_paper_runtime_monitoring_sessions() reads from the reconciler's /api/fleet/state. scripts/ensure_devloop_paper_runtime_worker.sh already targets the correct compose service name ('paper-fleet-reconciler', matching docker-compose.yml line 2208) and container name ('pantheon-paper-fleet-reconciler-1'); it is not a source of the failure. The recorded zero-session observation on the dev host is therefore explained by finding 1 (no active binding existed for the reconciler to spawn a worker against), not by a defect inside paper_runtime.py's own boot/heartbeat code.
root_cause_analysis.bug_fixed_stale_importlib_path: services/control-plane/governance/paper_runtime_binding.py hardcoded an importlib.util.spec_from_file_location path to services/execution/runtime-manager/runtime_binding.py. Commit 1a21a81bf (ACG-RUNTIME-MANAGER-20260828) moved RuntimeBinding to services/runtime_manager/runtime_binding.py (a proper importable package, per that commit's own message 'Replace sys.path and importlib path loading with standard Python imports') but never updated this caller, leaving it importing a file that no longer exists. Every import of paper_runtime_binding.py raised FileNotFoundError at module load time, breaking services/control-plane/governance/test_paper_runtime_binding.py collection entirely (pre-existing, unrelated to the dev deploy failure itself, but blocking this task's own test execution). Fixed by removing the importlib.util dynamic-loader dance and replacing it with the standard 'from services.runtime_manager.runtime_binding import RuntimeBinding, RuntimeBindingError, RuntimeBindingStatus, validate_binding' import, matching the pattern used by every other already-consolidated caller (services/runtime_manager/service.py, services/runtime-manager/runtime_manager_client.py, services/control-plane/bff/runtime/router.py, services/governance/ep5_proof/rollback_drill_harness.py).

ac1_failure_reproduced.proof: services/runtime-manager/test_runtime_manager.py::RuntimeManagerClientTests::test_reproduces_recorded_zero_active_bindings_before_deploy proves list_by_plan(plan_id) returns exactly [] before any dispatch, matching the recorded observed value; services/deployment/test_runtime_manager_dispatch_adapter.py::TestReproduceRecordedZeroBindingFailure::test_admitted_plan_has_zero_bindings_before_dispatch_is_ever_called and ::test_single_dispatch_call_promotes_plan_to_exactly_one_active_binding prove the same zero-binding state at the dispatch adapter boundary and that dispatch produces exactly one binding with no parallel path; services/execution/lean_runtime/test_paper_runtime.py::TestRuntimeTelemetryEmitter::test_reproduces_zero_authoritative_sessions_when_binding_never_resolves proves emit_heartbeat() returns False (no session-producing heartbeat is ever sent) when no RuntimeBinding resolves, matching the recorded zero-session observation.

ac2_runtime_binding_owner.proof: services/deployment/outbox_consumer_worker.py's runtime.binding.requested handler (lines ~2160-2308) together with services/deployment/runtime_manager_dispatch_adapter.py::dispatch_to_runtime_manager and services/runtime-manager/runtime_manager_client.py already constitute the single, complete, authoritative-readback-gated promotion path from an approved DeploymentPlan to an active RuntimeBinding. Reviewed for a functional gap (wrong condition, stub, swallowed error, unreachable branch) and found none. Strengthened with TestReproduceRecordedZeroBindingFailure (see AC1) proving single-path idempotent promotion. No parallel promotion path was introduced.

ac3_paper_worker_heartbeat_owner.proof: services/execution/lean_runtime/paper_runtime.py::PaperRuntimeService.start()/. _heartbeat_loop()/RuntimeTelemetryEmitter.emit_heartbeat() already boot a dedicated heartbeat thread independent of signal-drain backlog and publish heartbeat telemetry events carrying the resolved RuntimeBinding's authoritative identity fields. Existing tests (test_start_emits_heartbeat_before_background_lifecycle_replay, test_dedicated_heartbeat_continues_while_replay_is_blocked) plus the new test_reproduces_zero_authoritative_sessions_when_binding_never_resolves prove a session only ever appears when an underlying worker with a resolved binding is actually publishing -- a session reporting health without an underlying worker is not possible because build_event() refuses to construct a payload without a resolved binding's full identity.

ac4_owner_boundary_check.detail: Neither missing owner proved to sit outside the declared artifact contract; both RuntimeBinding creation (services/deployment/outbox_consumer_worker.py + runtime_manager_dispatch_adapter.py + runtime_manager_client.py) and paper worker heartbeat publication (services/execution/lean_runtime/paper_runtime.py) are already fully implemented inside the declared artifacts. No block condition was hit; no code outside the declared artifact list was touched.

ac5_negative_paths.proof: Absent binding: services/deployment/test_runtime_manager_dispatch_adapter.py::TestIdempotentReplay::test_binding_not_found_is_terminal_inconsistency and TestNewDispatch::test_missing_authoritative_readback_is_retryable. Stale/failed binding: new parametrized test_non_active_readback_status_is_terminal_not_fabricated_success (paused/pending_pause/failed/retired) asserts a real BINDING_READBACK_MISMATCH reason naming the offending status is surfaced and result.succeeded() is False -- never a fabricated success. Absent heartbeat/binding for the worker: services/execution/lean_runtime/test_paper_runtime.py::test_binding_resolver_fails_closed_when_exact_worker_binding_missing (real last_error surfaced, no default identifier) and new test_reproduces_zero_authoritative_sessions_when_binding_never_resolves (emit_heartbeat returns False, urlopen never called, no fabricated payload). Stale heartbeat delivery failure: RuntimeTelemetryEmitter.emit_payload already records self._last_error and returns False on any HTTP/network failure rather than reporting success, covered by existing emitter tests.

ac6_regression_recorded.proof: See test_executions below. 0 failures across 210 tests + 30 subtests in the combined declared-artifact test run; no positives were replaced by skips.

ac7_scope_discipline.detail: All changes are source-file edits and unit/regression test additions within the declared artifact list plus this evidence manifest. No hosted deployment, no docker-compose changes, no redeploy, no live trading or capital-affecting code path was touched.

test_executions.error: FileNotFoundError: services/execution/runtime-manager/runtime_binding.py (stale importlib path, fixed in this task)

test_executions.note: 21 pre-existing failures observed on first run were caused by a stale system typing_extensions==4.10.0 shadowing pydantic_core's requirement (unrelated to this task's changes, environment-only); resolved by 'pip install typing_extensions>=4.16' into .venv-pantheon, no repository file changed.
